articles.title: BCCI Plans FTP Overhaul After Overseas Collapses and Mounting Injury Crisis
articles.excerpt: After series defeats in Ireland and England and a wave of player injuries, the BCCI will push for rest periods and acclimatisation windows before future SENA tours in the next scheduling cycle.
articles.image_caption: The BCCI headquarters. The board has convened a review meeting to address India's overseas performance and growing injury concerns.
articles.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans globally are watching whether the BCCI's promised scheduling changes will better protect player welfare ahead of high-stakes overseas tours.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mandhana's Record-Breaking India Face Pakistan in Women's T20 Asia Cup Showdown
articles.excerpt: India, riding Smriti Mandhana's historic 124 against Hong Kong, take on traditional rivals Pakistan in their final Group A match in Dubai on Saturday.
articles.image_caption: Smriti Mandhana leads India against Pakistan in the Women's T20 Asia Cup in Dubai.
articles.nri_angle: The India-Pakistan rivalry in women's cricket continues to captivate diaspora fans worldwide, with Saturday's match carrying extra significance after Mandhana's historic milestone.

articles.title: BCCI Bans U-19 Spinner for Age Fraud as Bengal Cricket Flags 62 Players
articles.excerpt: The Cricket Association of Bengal has declared 62 players ineligible over age and documentation discrepancies, including a member of India's 2022 Under-19 World Cup-winning squad.
articles.image_caption: The BCCI has imposed a two-year ban on Bengal U-19 spinner Rohit Yadav for possessing multiple birth certificates.
articles.nri_angle: Age fraud in Indian cricket has long been a point of discussion among diaspora fans who follow domestic and youth cricket — this crackdown signals the BCCI is taking structural steps to address the problem.

articles.title: Smriti Mandhana Becomes All-Time Highest Run-Scorer in Women's International Cricket
articles.excerpt: The Indian opener surpassed Mithali Raj's 10,868-run mark with a record-breaking 124 off 64 balls against Hong Kong at the Women's T20 Asia Cup in Dubai.
articles.image_caption: Smriti Mandhana has surpassed Mithali Raj to become the all-time highest run-scorer in women's international cricket.
articles.nri_angle: India's vice-captain cements her legacy as one of cricket's all-time greats, a source of immense pride for the Indian diaspora worldwide.

articles.image_caption: VVS Laxman, who will coach India's men's cricket team at the 2026 Asian Games in Japan.

articles.title: Srikanth Falls in China Masters Quarterfinals After Stunning Victor Lai Upset
articles.excerpt: Former world No. 1 Kidambi Srikanth earned his first Super 750 quarterfinal in three years but fell 16-21, 16-21 to Lee Cheuk Yiu at Shenzhen Arena.
articles.image_caption: Kidambi Srikanth, who lost to Victor Lai in the China Masters quarterfinals.

articles.excerpt: India's pace spearhead is back in the 15-member squad for the three-match T20I series in New Delhi, with Shreyas Iyer captaining and teenager Vaibhav Sooryavanshi earning a call-up.
